Question: Should I get trip insurance?
Other ways to ask (separate with ;): cancellation insurance; travel insurance; do I need insurance
Answer: Trip insurance is optional. Without it, cancelling after the deadline means SkiSync can't refund you, because the money has already gone to resort partners. If you do have it, send your cancellation to SkiSync before you file a claim. Separately, winter sports and mountain rescue cover is mandatory, so keep your policy details on your phone.

Other ways to ask (separate with ;): can I cancel; cancel my trip; refund; transfer my spot; give my place to a friend; deadline
Answer: 10 Dec 2026: last day to cancel lift passes or rentals for a refund (minus the 4% card fee). 20 Dec 2026: the transfer fee goes up. 26 Dec 2026: all transfers stop. Cancelling costs a fee, and lodging, the social package and the deposit are non-refundable. Transfers only go to someone brand new, SkiSync needs about 10 days, so start early. Do it inside the SkiSync system.
